simulations.title: Cash Runway Squeeze
simulations.friendlyDesc: Stress-tests cash flows. Depletes cash reserves to under 0.5 months and centers payments on a single vendor to evaluate vendor default vulnerabilities.

simulations.title: Phishing Storm & MFA Gaps
simulations.description: Turn off MFA during a phishing storm.
simulations.friendlyDesc: Stress-tests access security. Turns off MFA administrative requirements globally while initiating a wave of phishing credential traps.

simulations.title: Supply Chain Compliance Gap
simulations.description: Set a low-security supplier to expire soon.
simulations.friendlyDesc: Stress-tests supplier reliance. Sets a key supplier to expire in under 30 days while lowering their security rating to a vulnerable level (42).

simulations.title: Sudden Revenue Drop Deficit
simulations.description: Drop revenue by 40% with high burn rate.
simulations.friendlyDesc: Stress-tests solvency. Reduces revenue inflow by 40% and increases cash outflows to simulate a lost business segment and evaluate capital runway.

simulations.title: Disaster Backup Outage
simulations.description: Fail backups with open critical CVEs.
simulations.friendlyDesc: Stress-tests business recovery. Disables database backup schedules and exposes the system to active unpatched cybersecurity exploits.

simulations.title: Geopolitical Sanctions Delay
simulations.description: Vendor relocated to highly sanctioned zone.
simulations.friendlyDesc: Stress-tests procurement. Simulates placing your primary shipping supplier on active geopolitical trade watchlists, delaying shipments.

simulations.title: Insider Threat & Access Leak
simulations.description: Employee leaks credentials with high open vulnerabilities.
simulations.friendlyDesc: Stress-tests authorization risk. Simulates a security awareness failure where a high-privilege user leaks system credentials while training completion is extremely low (15%).

simulations.title: Global Raw Material Inflation
simulations.description: Increase operating costs by 50% and delay AR collections.
simulations.friendlyDesc: Stress-tests margin pressure. Simulates global supply chain inflation by increasing monthly burn rate by 50% and doubling late payment receivables to 45%.

simulations.title: Regulatory Non-Compliance Audit
simulations.description: Triggers a $150k compliance fine and freezes backups.
simulations.friendlyDesc: Stress-tests regulatory resilience. Triggers an audit failure under compliance regulations resulting in a $150,000 regulatory fine (deducted from cash) and backup status disabled.

threatPlaybooks.title: Low Cash Reserves + Ransomware Exposure
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when the client cash runway is thin (< 4 months) and Multi-Factor Authentication is disabled.
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: A cyber incident will trigger catastrophic operational failure as the firm has insufficient cash buffers to absorb invoice delays or a high insurance deductible ($50k), coupled with zero recovery insulation due to disabled MFA.
recommendations: Enforce MFA globally across all email accounts immediately.
Secure short-term invoice factoring lines to raise working capital reserves.
preventiveMeasures: Schedule monthly ransomware tabletop response drills.
Enforce automated daily backup synchronization logs.

threatPlaybooks.title: Customer Concentration + Declining Liquidity
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when customer concentration exceeds 35% and cash runway is less than 6 months.
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: Severe dependency on a single customer makes cash flows extremely fragile. If the primary client delays standard invoice settlements, immediate solvency failure is likely.
recommendations: Initiate customer acquisition campaigns to dilute top client share below 25%.
Negotiate shorter credit terms (e.g., Net 15 instead of Net 45) with the top customer.
preventiveMeasures: Purchase accounts receivable credit insurance policies.
Establish a minimum operating cash reserve of 6 months.

threatPlaybooks.title: Vendor Concentration + Poor Liquidity
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when vendor concentration exceeds 30% and runway is less than 8 months.
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: High reliance on a centralized supply chain creates a single point of operational failure. Vendor default or pricing squeezes will impact product deliverables.
recommendations: Onboard secondary suppliers to mitigate raw materials dependencies.
Run quarterly security assessments on your critical vendors.
preventiveMeasures: Add strict SLA performance penalty clauses in supplier agreements.
Maintain an updated catalog of alternative vendors.

threatPlaybooks.title: Weak Cybersecurity + Cyber Insurance Gaps
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when MFA is disabled and cyber insurance is not maintained.
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: Operating without cyber liability coverage while maintaining disabled MFA exposes the business to unrecoverable ransomware extortion costs and data breach penalties.
recommendations: Activate baseline MFA policies on all administrative and employee portals.
Request cyber liability quotes immediately to establish risk transfer.
preventiveMeasures: Schedule automated quarterly vulnerability patch reviews.
Implement strict remote employee endpoint connection policies.

threatPlaybooks.title: Cash Runway Below 12 Months in Healthcare Sector (v1)
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when working capital runway falls below 12 months for Healthcare firms.
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: Operating runway below 12 months limits long-term growth investments and increases dependency on immediate cash inflows.
recommendations: Optimize non-essential administrative spending.
Review billing terms with professional clients.
preventiveMeasures: Build a 6-month capital buffer reserve account.
Implement monthly accounts receivable reviews.

threatPlaybooks.title: Cash Runway Below 6 Months in Healthcare Sector (v1)
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when cash runway drops below 6 months under active burn rates.
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: Resilience is impaired. A 6-month cash cushion leaves little buffer to absorb contract cancellations or billing collection delays.
recommendations: Freeze discretionary CapEx spend immediately.
Follow up on all overdue invoices past 30 days.
preventiveMeasures: Establish pre-approved working capital lines of credit.
Transition to bi-weekly billing schedules.

threatPlaybooks.title: Cash Runway Below 3 Months in Healthcare Sector (v1)
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when cash reserves are critically thin (< 3 months runway).
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: Extremely high threat of operational insolvency. Immediate capital injections or cash infusions are required to maintain payroll.
recommendations: Negotiate accounts payable extensions with core partners.
Apply for emergency financing lines.
preventiveMeasures: Implement rigid daily cash-flow monitoring models.
Maintain a baseline survival budget blueprint.

threatPlaybooks.title: High Customer Concentration Risk in Healthcare Sector (v1)
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when customer concentration index is elevated (> 30%).
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: Severe dependency on a single customer. Loss or payment delay of this client will result in immediate operational distress.
recommendations: Diversify marketing budget to target new demographics.
Renegotiate contract terms to include termination penalties.
preventiveMeasures: Conduct quarterly client revenue contribution assessments.
Purchase accounts receivable trade credit insurance.

threatPlaybooks.title: Net Operational Losses in Healthcare Sector (v1)
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when net monthly income falls into a negative deficit.
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: Active business operations are burning cash reserves, shortening the runway and eroding working capital balance.
recommendations: Execute a 15% freeze on overhead and software spend.
Audit variable costs and supplier margins.
preventiveMeasures: Implement weekly budget control authorization rules.
Enforce strict margin targets on new quotes.

threatPlaybooks.title: High Vendor Concentration Risk in Healthcare Sector (v1)
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when supplier spend concentration exceeds 30%.
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: High supply chain vulnerability. If your top vendor fails or raises pricing, operations will halt or margins collapse.
recommendations: Identify and onboard alternative backup suppliers.
Request quotes from secondary local distributors.
preventiveMeasures: Implement multi-sourcing supply strategies.
Audit vendor financial stability annually.

threatPlaybooks.title: Disabled Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) - Healthcare Security (v1)
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when MFA is inactive on critical employee administrative channels.
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: Disabled MFA exposes the business to automated credentials stuffing, business email compromise, and network breaches.
recommendations: Enforce mandatory MFA globally across all email accounts today.
Block legacy non-MFA login protocols.
preventiveMeasures: Configure Single Sign-On (SSO) central security controls.
Run automated monthly identity auditing checks.

threatPlaybooks.title: Outdated or Missing Backup Systems - Healthcare Security (v1)
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when database backup status is outdated or not configured.
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: High ransomware impact. System infiltration will cause permanent data loss with zero capability to restore systems.
recommendations: Execute full backup updates to isolated offline storage now.
Establish daily automated backup cron jobs.
preventiveMeasures: Test disaster recovery restore capabilities quarterly.
Implement immutable read-only cloud backups.

threatPlaybooks.title: Elevated System Vulnerabilities CVEs - Healthcare Security (v1)
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when open vulnerabilities count is high (> 5 CVEs).
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: Malicious actors can exploit known software vulnerabilities to execute code or access servers without authorization.
recommendations: Deploy critical patch updates on all server nodes today.
Isolate unpatched legacy servers from the web.
preventiveMeasures: Enable automated weekly vulnerability patch management tools.
Establish continuous endpoint security checking.

threatPlaybooks.title: Low Security Awareness Training Completion - Healthcare Security (v1)
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when employee security training is incomplete (< 70%).
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: Creates human vulnerabilities. Staff are susceptible to phishing links and credential harvesting campaigns.
recommendations: Launch mandatory phishing awareness courses for all staff.
Set a 14-day completion deadline for default profiles.
preventiveMeasures: Automate security training requirements for new hires.
Run monthly simulated phishing test drills.

threatPlaybooks.title: Workforce Headcount Expansion Risks - Healthcare Operations (v1)
threatPlaybooks.description: Triggered when headcount growth expands (> 50 employees) without mature compliance controls.
threatPlaybooks.potentialImpact: Operational complexity increases. High risk of policy dilution and unmonitored shadow IT accounts.
recommendations: Deploy centralized Active Directory access policies.
Distribute formal employee security handbook copies.
preventiveMeasures: Establish structured onboarding and offboarding exit checksheets.
Audit employee access logs monthly.
